title: Kuva Hek
extract:
The Kuva Hek is the Kuva variant of the  Hek shotgun, with boosts to its critical chance and falloff range, along with its damage, critical multiplier, and status chance surpassing the  Vaykor Hek. It has the unique ability to fire all four barrels simultaneously via Alternate Fire.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.
Alternate Fire shoots four shots simultaneously.
Builds meant to utilize the alternate fire benefit significantly from reload modding, such as ( Primed)  Tactical Pump.
Alternate Fire consumes 4 rounds of ammunition, effectively resulting in a 1-round magazine that, without ammo efficiency sources such as  Primary Crux, prevents the alt fire from being used in tandem with the primary fire and must reload after every shot. With Primary Crux the alternate fire may be used 2-3 times before reloading.
Can use the  Hek-exclusive  Scattered Justice mod.
Adversary Weapon:
Comes with an additional bonus  Impact,  Heat,  Cold,  Electricity,  Toxin,  Magnetic, or  Radiation damage, based on the Kuva Lich's progenitor Warframe, which increases the listed base damage of the weapon by 25%-60%.
Valence Fusion can optionally change the resulting output damage type, and can upgrade the bonus increase (up to 60%).
Polarizing the weapon increases its max rank by 2, capping at rank 40 after 5 polarizations, granting the weapon additional mod capacity.
 Elemental Vice can be applied to the weapon after it has reached rank 40, allowing the bonus damage type to be swapped freely.
Listed Mastery Rank requirement is not enforced - the weapon may theoretically be obtained at any mastery rank by acquiring and vanquishing a Kuva Lich that has this weapon equipped.
Advantages over other Primary  Shotgun weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Innate multishot of 7 pellets.
Tied with normal  Hek,  Vaykor Hek, and  Corinth for the second-narrowest pellet spread of all shotguns, behind  Exergis.

Acquisition

Kuva Hek is obtained by vanquishing a Kuva Lich who generated with one equipped. After the Lich is vanquished it will be in the player's Foundry ready to claim.
While the weapon itself is not tradeable, a converted Kuva Lich generated with the weapon can be traded to another player. The trade is performed inside a Clan Dojo's Crimson Branch room, and the recipient must not have any active Lich. Once traded, the recipient must fight and vanquish the Lich to claim its weapon.

Notes
Alt fire cannot be used if there are less than 4 rounds in the magazine. Attempting to alt fire with less than 4 rounds will result in a reload instead.
The four-round burst consumption is consistent even if mods increasing magazine capacity such as  Ammo Stock is equipped. It does allow the player to shoot extra rounds first before eventually using the alt-fire or, if  Burdened Magazine is also equipped, two alt-fire bursts in sequence.
If magazine capacity is decreased below 4 rounds (such as with a riven) then the alt fire becomes unusable.
Alternatively, using  Primed Ammo Stock grants four additional shots of the above two mods while only occupying one slot, resulting in an overall DPS increase by using the saved up slot for another damage-based mod.
If the player is under an ammo-efficiency effect (such as Void Fuel or Energized Munitions), alt fire can be used with fewer than 4 rounds in the magazine. A reload is triggered when attempting to fire when consumption exceeds current magazine capacity.

Adversary Notes
For weapons obtained from vanquishing the Kuva Lich or Sister:
The player does not have to meet the Mastery Rank displayed to obtain this weapon. It can simply be claimed from the foundry after the Lich/Sister carrying it has been vanquished.
The weapon will have a prefix of the name of the Lich/Sister it was acquired from (e.g. a Kuva Kohm might be called "Odizrigg Agekk Kuva Kohm").
Refraining from Mercy killing an Adversary candidate and letting them die will remove their weapon from the pool of potential Adversary weapons until each has been refused, but only if the mission is completed. Weapons rejected from aborted missions will remain in the current cycle.
It is also possible for the weapon to be removed from the cycle even without waiting for the Adversary candidate to die before extracting from the mission.
For weapons obtained from Ergo Glast's and Eleanor's shop:
The player must meet the Mastery Rank displayed to obtain this weapon, as it is claimed from an NPC shop rather than the foundry.
The weapon's max rank caps at 40 after 5 polarizations (max rank increases by 2 per Forma added).
Additional polarizations can be added when the weapon reaches its new max rank at that polarization level.
Each additional rank also gives 100 Mastery Rank experience, giving 4,000 points in total at level 40.
Mod capacity scales with the additional ranks, and can reach a total of 80 at rank 40 with an Orokin Catalyst installed.
Without an Orokin Catalyst, the max is 40. Combined with the five polarized mod slots required to reach that point, an Orokin Catalyst might not be required for some beginner-friendly builds as they typically use less mod capacity.
After polarizing a weapon, any additional mod capacity above 30 (60 with an Orokin Catalyst) will not take effect until the weapon's rank reaches 31 and above.
Legendary Mastery Rank increases the minimum mod capacity for such weapons, without the weapon needing to be rank 31 and above. For example, Legendary 1 increases the minimum capacity to 31 (62 with an Orokin Catalyst).
Comes with an additional damage stat.
For Lich/Sister-obtained weapons this is dependent on the Warframe that summoned the Lich/Sister.
For Ergo Glast's and Eleanor's shops a random bonus stat will be offered for each weapon and changed every 4 days (96 hours).
This damage stat randomly ranges between 25%-60%. It can be upgraded up to its maximum value with Valence Fusion using another copy of the weapon.
The element of this bonus can be changed at will among the available Valence elements once an Elemental Vice is applied.
This bonus stat is considered a base damage type and will be applied after all elemental mods for the purposes of elemental combinations. It uses the weapon's falloff range but always scales linearly from 100% to 0%, regardless of what the weapon's falloff damage scaling is.

*Note that the Primed or Umbra version of a Warframe share the same element

Tips
As with most weapons with the ability to unload an entire magazine in a single burst, the Kuva Hek's alt-fire synergizes well with  Mag's short-tap  Magnetize bubble, as the quick torrent of shot can pulverize crowds of enemies caught in the bubble.
 Primed Ammo Stock grants the Kuva Hek twice the magazine capacity, allowing for two quick successions of its alt-fire and increasing the already powerful shotgun's overall DPS.
As both firing modes have Semi Trigger Types, the Kuva Hek can equip  Semi-Shotgun Cannonade both to increase damage and add Punch Through.

Trivia
The Grineer text translates into MIS4TUNE (Misfortune).

Bugs
Manually reloading after the alt fire will use a soundless Braton reload animation.
